notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Central US Lookouts page and the statewide list give county and forest only. The FFLA list gives coordinates and gone status. The OSM node gives the name and observation tag. Two searches found no build date, staffing or fire history. The Nicolet National Forest history PDF (1928-1976, foresthistory.org) lists a Newald CCC camp (F-102) but no lookout tower; it is not cited. The OSM point is about 100 m from the FFLA point; the record keeps the FFLA point. The anyplaceamerica.com entry returned HTTP 403, so it was not read.
